invariants.rationale: The method returns fileHandles, so at exit result is always equal to fileHandles.
Since fileHandles is returned (potentially augmented in-place), the result's size cannot be less than what fileHandles had at method entry.
tileSet is used after potential re-assignment and checked for properties, so it must not be null at method exit.
tmjFile is used in getRelativeFileHandle and potentially assigned to tsjFile, so it must be non-null at method exit.
result is an Array<FileHandle> and its size is always non-negative.
